summary_notes: Nadia Prewitt-Okafor (DOB 11/27/1984, member HVD-6044-1829, Halvard Select PPO) called because Larkspur warned her 10/8 7:20 AM lumbar MRI (CPT 72148, Dr. Okonjo-Reyes) would be cancelled for lack of auth. Identity verified. Practice had faxed the PA twice to Halvard's retired UM fax line (555-0144, retired 8/31); it was never received. After lengthy holds, Halvard UM (Devon) opened expedited case PA-2609-55170 (72-hour decision); agent uploaded order, PT notes (7/31-9/11, 8 visits), and office note. Benefits: $1,500 deductible, $1,210 met, 80% after deductible; 22 PT visits remaining. Patient reported new toe tingling; message to physician planned, ER red flags reviewed. Agent to notify Larkspur, monitor portal, and call patient; husband needs proxy form.

Deductible figure corrected: initially quoted $1,120 met, refreshed to $1,210 met, leaving $290 before 80% coinsurance

Root cause: Halvard UM fax 555-0144 was retired August 31; new fax is 555-0188; Brightwater's fax template still showed the old number ('updated March 2025'), so other pending requests may also be affected
Patient's name frequently misheard as 'Nadine Prewitt'; correct name is Nadia Prewitt-Okafor
MRI details: Thursday, October 8 at 7:20 AM at Larkspur Surgery and Endoscopy Center; Larkspur's cancellation deadline was Friday, October 2; next available slot otherwise November
Clinical picture: lumbar radiculopathy (M54.16) and lumbago with sciatica, left (M54.42); injury July lifting a crate of eggs at bakery work; order priority 'routine'; no red flags per note
New symptom raised in passing: tingling in the toes for the past week - agent appropriately escalated to the ordering provider rather than dismissing it
Work injury was never reported to workers' comp; Halvard confirmed it can be processed under the health plan
PT benefit: 30 visits/year combined, 8 used, 22 remaining, no referral needed, just a prescription
Expedited review (72 hours) vs standard (up to 15 calendar days); peer-to-peer and appeal explained as fallbacks
Husband is not on the patient's release form; patient agreed to add him via portal under 'authorizations and proxies'; until then only the patient can be spoken to
Patient's callback number confirmed as her cell ending 0166; member portal path for auth status is 'My Care' > 'Authorizations'
Patient keeps a notebook of every call on her sister's (a paralegal's) advice
